message:
E2E agent tool smoke. Do not create an artifact, workbook, HTML, PDF, file, or download. Do not calculate the answer yourself. Use the hidden PII relationship calculation tool only. Tool operation must be xlsx_formula_plan. Return only a short text summary of the tool result: operation, targetCells, privacy flags, and formula summary. Do not return the highest individual, winnerPlaceholder, aggregateValue, ranked result, raw names, or placeholder relationships.
